summary: Translated src/en/module_01/10-concepts-a.md (sections s1-s4) into src/zh/module_01/10-concepts-a.md. check.mjs reports 0 errors; the 7 'looks untranslated' warnings are all display-maths lines, so they are false positives.
changes: feature vector -> 特征输入向量（feature vector), to avoid clashing with 特征向量 = eigenvector
coefficient of determination -> 决定系数
expected risk / empirical risk -> 期望风险 / 经验风险
Cholesky / QR / SVD kept in Latin; SVD given as 奇异值分解（SVD）
epoch -> 轮次, as the glossary has it
ext{} in maths: so -> 于是 / 故, for large kappa -> 当 kappa 很大时, floor -> 下限
issues: ext{} with Chinese inside display maths was accepted by check.mjs without KaTeX errors.
